purpose: Teach: 打ち切り/有価/作り上げる/使い捨て/版元/レスポンス/率先/囲む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、赤字事業の打ち切りも視野に入れろ
lines.en: We need to consider shutting down unprofitable divisions.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clipped pace on the key phrase. No room for negotiation in the tone, but not unkind — the clarity of someone who has already thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有価証券の運用方針を見直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review our investment strategy for securities.
lines.style: Attentive, note-taking energy. Steady pace, no hesitation. The confidence of someone who knows what they're responsible for and will deliver on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員と共にブランドを作り上げる
lines.en: We build our brand together with our people.
lines.style: Shift to conviction. Slower, more deliberate than the previous directive. Weight on 「together」 — this is philosophy, not procedure. Eye-level, almost confiding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。使い捨てプラスチックの削減も進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll also accelerate our reduction of single-use plastics.
lines.style: Absorbing the pivot quickly. Slight breath in after the opening acknowledgment — processing that this matters to him. Engaged, not mechanical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書籍の版元と交渉しろ
lines.style: Back to command tone, but slightly lighter than the first line. Specific, actionable. The tone of someone who trusts the person receiving the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客レスポンスを高めます
lines.en: Understood. I'm coordinating upgrades to the executive conference room.
lines.style: Continues the responsive energy. Small note of forward momentum on this item — he's already working on it. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が率先して改革を進めろ
lines.en: Our people lead the reform. That's the path forward.
lines.style: Returns to slower, conviction-level delivery. Not a question. Slight emphasis on 「lead」 — this is the framework everything else hangs on. Almost meditative clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員会議室を新装備で囲む計画です
lines.en: Yes. The executive meeting room will be outfitted and ready.
lines.style: Closing note of confirmation. Soft landing — not an afterthought, but the practical tail of the meeting. Kenji's check-in before stepping out. Measured, complete.
